schoolCalendar.title: School Calendar (Program starting dates)
description: The program strating date varies depending on F1 or Non F1 students.

lists.key: Non F1 students who don't obtain a student visa.
value:
Can start their program on any Monday.
If Monday is a holiday, then the program starting date will be Tuesday for that week.

lists.key: F1 students who obtain a student (F) visa.
value: Can start on specific Mondays. (high-lighted in yellow on the Calendar).

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about arrival dates in the U.S.

lists.key: Q: How many days before the program starting date can a student enter the U.S?
value:
A: MLI doesn't require our students to come to the U.S. a specific number of days in advance.
However, our students usually enter the U.S 1 or 2 days before their program starting dates.
lists.note: Note: International students are allowed to enter the U.S. 30 days prior to their program starting dates.

lists.key: Q: Is it possible to move into the accommodation before the program starting dates?
value:
A: Yes. We can arrange your accommodation moving in date as any date.
If there are other questions, please do not hesitate to consult us.
